title: Schedule of Issuance, Delivery and Renewal Terms — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card
content:
**Schedule A — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card: issuance charges, delivery times, renewal and activation periods, by tier.**

| Card tier | Custom design fee (USD) | Expedited shipping fee (USD) | Standard delivery, latest arrival (business days after issue) | Expedited delivery, latest arrival (business days after issue) | Renewal issued (calendar days before the expiry month starts) | Activation window (calendar days after issue) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | 5.00 | 25.00 | 10 | 3 | 30 | 60 |
| Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | 5.00 | 25.00 | 10 | 3 | 30 | 60 |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | 0.00 | 15.00 | 10 | 3 | 30 | 60 |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 0.00 | 15.00 | 7 | 2 | 45 | 90 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 0.00 | 0.00 | 7 | 2 | 45 | 90 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 0.00 | 0.00 | 5 | 2 | 60 | 90 |

**Notes to Schedule A**

1. The custom design fee is a one-time fee for a physical card carrying a custom design. It is charged on the card's issue date.
2. The expedited shipping fee is charged on the issue date of a physical card sent by expedited delivery.
3. The delivery columns give the latest arrival of a physical card, counted in business days after the issue date: the standard column for standard delivery, the expedited column for expedited delivery.
4. Virtual cards are issued instantly. They carry no delivery fee and no design fee.
5. A renewal card is issued automatically the stated number of calendar days before the first day of the current card's expiry month. It carries no fee.
6. The activation window is the number of calendar days after the issue date within which an ordered physical card must be activated before it is closed.

**Illustration (hypothetical order).** A customer on Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit orders a physical card with a custom design and expedited delivery. On the issue date the card carries a custom design fee of 5.00 and an expedited shipping fee of 25.00, a total of 30.00 in issuance charges, and it arrives no later than 3 business days after the issue date. The same order on Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit carries 0.00 of each fee and arrives no later than 2 business days after the issue date.
